Name: Oded, Father of Azariah
Summary: Oded was the father of Azariah the prophet; the record also speaks of 'the prophecy of Oded the prophet' which Asa heard, though 2 Chronicles does not state plainly whether father or son spoke it.
KeyStory: When Asa heard the words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage and put away the abominable idols.
RelatedPeople: Azariah, Son of Oded; King Asa
LifeLesson: God's word, whether through father or son, bears the same call: seek Him while He may be found.
